children: Brazilian right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro overtook leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and held a narrow lead in Sunday's presidential election runoff, an early vote count from the country's electoral authority showed.
With 13.65% of ballots tallied, Bolsonaro had 50.01% of the valid votes - which exclude blank and null ballots - against Lula's 49.99%, according to Brazil's Superior Electoral Court.
